name: Moral Hazard and Backstop Expectation
definition: An expectation of rescue, retry, or rollback changes risk taking before any rescue occurs.
trigger_conditions: Failed actions can be retried at no cost to standing
A human or protocol operator is expected to reverse bad outcomes
Slashing is discretionary rather than automatic

institutional_antecedent.mechanism: limited liability as a driver of excessive risk taking

citation: W. A. Kaal, ed., Agent Failure Mode Registry version 1.0, AFMR-F008 Moral Hazard and Backstop Expectation. https://wulfkaal.github.io/afmr/AFMR-F008
